name: tow
description: Manage documents inside an Obsidian vault with content-preserving formatting, frontmatter and optional user-guided post-curation.

interface.longDescription: Work inside an Obsidian vault to search notes, manage selected frontmatter and fix Markdown, math, code and table formatting while preserving their content. Optional post-curation follows your templates and explicit choices. Requires local vault access and Python 3.10+; optional parsing/ontology uses Node.js 22.18+ and the tag-ontology npm CLI. Your agent host processes opened content and controls permissions. TOW has no hosted backend.
defaultPrompt: Find my project notes about RAG.
Check the formatting of these notes without changing their content.
Suggest concept tags for this note.
